facts.text: Through its One Price Promise, University of the Cumberlands includes tuition and all fees in a single published price of $9,875 without housing or $19,175 or less with housing.

sources.title: Financial Aid & Tuition — Affordable College in Kentucky
sources.quote: On-campus undergraduate: $9,875 without housing or $19,175 or less with housing, according to the University's published pricing.
